items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: The mention of Will Vodery appears only in a [NOTE] by the interviewer ('them, with Will Vodery,') and is not confirmed or elaborated upon by the interviewee in the provided text.

ctx.x: Well, then, this is my first feeling of a big band with pro's, everybody was a pro. You have records behind/I played so and so, I played here and there. The fellow on the guitar, his name was Edward Gibbs. He was young, we were all sort of younger people. The key men were older people. And Henry Walton, I learned so much from him. Wisdom.
